Subject: Initial supplier evidence + where to send PO

Hi Hannah / Vanessa,

We're ready to move Redwood into our vendor registry but Procurement needs a few items before they can issue a PO: a signed DPA (or redline path), a copy or link to your latest SOC 2 report, a current subprocessor list, and a completed supplier form (attached). Can you confirm:

- Do you have a public SOC 2 report we can link to, or a letter of attestation?
- Will you accept our standard PO (we route to your billing email) or do you require a different PO flow?
- Any known subprocessors that handle customer data (names + locations)?

Attached: novablue_supplier_form_filled.pdf (their completed intake).

We need all items by the end of the week to hit our internal go-live on 8/28. Happy to set a 15-min call if that helps.

Thanks,
Carl Hayes
Senior Procurement Manager
NovaBlue
[Procurement: procurement@novablue.com]
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Aug 2028 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial supplier evidence + where to send PO

Hi Carl — thanks for the intake. Quick answers and next steps below.

1) DPA: attaching our current DPA (redlined copy available on request). If NovaBlue needs any specific clause, point us to the clause and we'll escalate.
[Attachment: redwood_dpa_v3.pdf (PDF, stub)]

2) SOC 2: public report link here: https://redwood.example.com/security/soc2-report-2028 — that page contains our auditor's summary and scope. For procurement, we can also provide a read-only link to the full report under NDA; let us know which you prefer.
[Attachment: redwood_soc2_public_report_link.txt]

3) Subprocessors: attached is our canonical list exported this month. Key ones: CloudStorageCo (US), MetricsStream (EU), NotificationHub (US). The CSV includes service, data type, and hosting region.
[Attachment: redwood_subprocessors_2028.csv]

4) PO routing & invoicing: please send the PO to billing@redwood.com and cc accounts-payable@redwood.com. We accept your standard PO terms; if you have non-standard payment terms >60 days, loop in finance (I can introduce). Our AP vendor code: RBW-00123 (include on the invoice).

If helpful, I can ping Legal to review any proposed redlines — otherwise, we can complete e-signature on the DPA via DocuSign (I'll send the link).

Propose a quick 15-min sync tomorrow at 9am PT to walk through the CSV if you want — otherwise we'll assume this package is sufficient for PO issuance.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Program Manager, Vendor Enablement
Redwood Inference
From: Carl Hayes <carl.hayes@novablue.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@novablue.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Aug 2028 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial supplier evidence + where to send PO

Thanks Hannah — this is great. Two quick follow-ups before procurement issues the PO:

1) Encryption question: we need confirmation that customer data at rest in CloudStorageCo is encrypted with customer-unique keys (KMS). Does Redwood enforce CMK per customer, or is it provider-managed keys?

2) Residency: NovaBlue requires EU-only processing for EU-customer PII. Can you confirm any routing options or region-locking for workloads?

3) Invoicing: confirm if you need the PO number on the invoice PDF or both PO number and the NovaBlue internal project code (NB-PROJ-770).

Attached: novablue_supplier_form_filled.pdf (their completed intake again for your reference).

If it helps, we can accept a short written confirmation on the encryption and residency items rather than a call.

Regards,
Carl
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Carl Hayes <carl.hayes@novablue.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Aug 2028 11:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial supplier evidence + where to send PO

Hi Carl — copying a short technical confirmation below.

On encryption: Redwood supports both provider-managed keys and customer-managed keys (CMK) via KMS integrations. For accounts that require CMKs we can configure customer-specific KMS keys so that CloudStorageCo-stored material is encrypted under per-customer keys. If NovaBlue wants CMKs for EU customers, we can add that to the setup checklist and validate key ownership during provisioning.

On residency: we provide region pinning for inference and storage. EU-customer PII can be routed to our EU region; subprocessors that process EU PII are identified in the attached CSV and most have EU hosting options. For strict EU-only processing, we'll need to lock the account to the EU region and limit failover behavior — that requires a short ops runbook which we can provide.

PO / invoice: please place the PO number on the invoice PDF and include the NovaBlue project code (NB-PROJ-770) in the invoice body. Billing email should receive the PO and the final invoice: billing@redwood.com.

Happy to join a 15-min call to walk through the CSV and confirm any CMK steps. If approved, I can prepare a short Ops checklist (key names, IAM roles, contact points) for your security team.

— Rishi
Principal Security Engineer
